image_description: A close-up view of a circular, wall-mounted aneroid barometer with a metallic rim and a white dial face. The dial features a central illustration of a bird (possibly a penguin or similar figure) and concentric rings of markings. There is text at the bottom of the image that appears to be gibberish or stylized non-Latin script. A portion of another similar instrument is visible at the top edge. The background is a plain, light-colored surface.
